name: Harbour Cafe chalkboard style (hard)
instruction: Rewrite the notice in the Harbour Cafe chalkboard style.
rules: All lowercase. A single line. At most 12 words before the signature. A playful twist that gives an object or situation a personality. No full stop. Always end with the signature ' ~ hc'.

examples.input: We will be closed on Monday for maintenance.
examples.output: closed monday, the espresso machine needs a spa day ~ hc

examples.input: New pastries are available starting this week.
examples.output: new pastries this week, come taste our experiments ~ hc

examples.input: Please return your cups to the counter.
examples.output: cups back on the counter please, they miss home ~ hc
cash only today, the card reader is sulking ~ hc

items.input: Due to a supplier delay, our Saturday 9am sourdough delivery will arrive after 11am, so loaves will be limited.
Please remember that loyalty cards expire on 31 December and cannot be extended.
Our kitchen stops serving hot food at 3pm. Sandwiches and cakes are available until closing.
Warning: the floor near the entrance is wet, please watch your step.
The Harbour Cafe will host a Jazz Night on Friday 14 June from 7pm. Tickets are 10 euros.
We have run out of oat milk today and apologise for any inconvenience.
